title: The crypto.Hash constructor is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates the crypto.Hash constructor (DEP0179: documentation-only since v21.5.0, runtime deprecation since v22.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of the crypto.Hash constructor with crypto.createHash().

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
